message:
You know, there’s something to be said for being prepared. I remember a time when my daughter was caught in a sudden snowstorm while driving with the kids. Thankfully, she had a little emergency kit in the trunk that made all the difference. I always used to tell her to be ready for anything, and this was one of those moments where I felt quite smug about it. 

Having a plan for your car can really ease the mind, especially when the unexpected happens. It’s about keeping those you love safe and sound, so why not take a moment to think about what you might need? What little essentials do you keep in your car for peace of mind?
